text: See, a king will reign justlyand princes will rule rightly. [AA]
Each of them will be like a shelter from the wind,a refuge from the rain.They will be like streams of water in a dry country,like the shade of a great rock in a parched land. [AB]
The eyes of those who see will not be closed;the ears of those who hear will be attentive. [AC]
The hasty of heart shall take thought to know,and tongues of stutterers shall speak readily and clearly.
No more will the fool be called noble,nor the deceiver be considered honorable. [AD]
For the fool speaks folly,his heart plans evil:Godless actions,perverse speech against the Lord,Letting the hungry go emptyand the thirsty without drink. [AE]
The deceits of the deceiver are evil,he plans devious schemes:To ruin the poor with lies,and the needy when they plead their case. [AF]
But the noble plan noble deeds,and in noble deeds they persist.
You women so complacent, rise up and hear my voice,daughters so confident, give heed to my words. [AG]
In a little more than a yearyour confidence will be shaken;For the vintage will fail,no fruit harvest will come in. [AH]
Tremble, you who are so complacent!Shudder, you who are so confident!Strip yourselves bare,with only a loincloth for cover. [AI]
Beat your breastsfor the pleasant fields,for the fruitful vine; [AJ]
For the soil of my people,overgrown with thorns and briers;For all the joyful houses,the exultant city. [AK]
The castle [1] will be forsaken,the noisy city deserted;Citadel and tower will become wasteland forever,the joy of wild donkeys, the pasture of flocks; [AL]
t[2] Until the spirit from on highis poured out on us.And the wilderness becomes a garden landand the garden land seems as common as forest. [AM]
Then judgment will dwell in the wildernessand justice abide in the garden land.
The work of justice will be peace;the effect of justice, calm and security forever. [AN]
My people will live in peaceful country,in secure dwellings and quiet resting places. [AO]
And the forest will come down completely,the city will be utterly laid low. [3] [AP]
Happy are you who sow beside every stream,and let the ox and the donkey go freely! [AQ]
